description: NaCu₃O₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbca space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of two NaCu₃O₂ sheets oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(0), np.int64(1)) direction. Na is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (2.23 Å) and one longer (2.36 Å) Na-O bond length. There are three inequivalent Cu sites. In the first Cu site, Cu is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.83 Å) and one longer (1.87 Å) Cu-O bond length. In the second Cu site, Cu is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.84 Å) and one longer (1.88 Å) Cu-O bond length. In the third Cu site, Cu is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.85 Å) and one longer (1.88 Å) Cu-O bond length. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal pyramidal geometry to one Na and three Cu atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na and three Cu atoms.
